explanation: ${500 \times 20{,}000 = 10^7}$ candidates per second, times ${10^7}$ FLOPs each, is ${10^{14}}$ FLOP/s $= 100$ TFLOP/s. A GPU that sustains 100 TFLOP/s on this small model would be a stretch (small batched MLPs rarely reach peak), so plan for several GPUs or many CPUs per region, or cut the candidates with a cheaper pre-ranker. This is why funnels have a light ranker before the heavy one.
